title: Ancient Buddhist Site of Sarnath Inscribed on UNESCO World Heritage List
description: The ancient Buddhist site of Sarnath has been inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List, marking a major milestone in the recognition and preservation of India’s rich Buddhist and cultural heritage. Located near Varanasi in Uttar Pradesh, Sarnath is one of the most significant sites associated with the life and teachings of Gautama Buddha and holds exceptional historical, archaeological, spiritual and cultural importance. Sarnath is revered as the place where Gautama Buddha delivered his first sermon, known as the Dharmachakra Pravartana, or the turning of the wheel of Dharma,...

title: Myanmar grants protected ancient building status to century-old Hsipaw Haw Palace
description: YANGON, July 27 (Xinhua) -- Myanmar's Ministry of Hotels, Tourism and Culture has officially designated the historic Hsipaw Haw Palace in Hsipaw township, northern Shan state, as a protected ancient building that is more than 100 years old.
